tool.name: Get.rabund
tool.description: Get rabund from a otu list or sabund
tool.command:
@SHELL_OPTIONS@
## create symlinks to input datasets ln -s '$count' count.dat && ln -s '$otu' otu.dat &&
## collect the arguments of the mothur command in a list and join them with ## commas, so that the command can never end with a trailing comma #set $mothur_args = [] #if $label: #silent $mothur_args.append("label=" + str(str($label).replace(",","-"))) #end if #if $count: #silent $mothur_args.append("count=count.dat") #end if #if $otu.is_of_type("mothur.list"): #silent $mothur_args.append("list=otu.dat") #elif $otu.is_of_type("mothur.sabund"): #silent $mothur_args.append("sabund=otu.dat") #end if #silent $mothur_args.append("sorted=" + str($sorted))
echo 'get.rabund(${",".join($mothur_args)})' | mothur | tee mothur.out.log

param.name: sorted
param.label: sorted - sort by abundance
param.help: By default the data in the rabund file the same order as the OTUs in input, select to sort by abundance.

tool.help:
@MOTHUR_OVERVIEW@
**Command Documentation**
The get.rabund_ command generates an rabund_ file from a list_ or sabund_ file.
.. _rabund: https://mothur.org/wiki/rabund_file/ .. _list: https://mothur.org/wiki/list_file/ .. _sabund: https://mothur.org/wiki/sabund_file/ .. _get.rabund: https://mothur.org/wiki/get.rabund/
